question: What diseases are caused by variants in the HNF1A gene?
answer_text:
Found 14 sequence variant records for HNF1A [1][2][3][4][5][6][8][13][15][16][17][18][19][20], linked to 6 diseases: Maturity-onset diabetes of the young [7], Diabetes mellitus type 1 [9], Type 2 diabetes mellitus [10], Maturity-onset diabetes of the young type 3 [11], Type 1 diabetes mellitus 20 [12] and Monogenic diabetes [14]. 

Additional named variants include "NM_000545.8(HNF1A):c.1524G>T (p.Glu508Asp)" [1], "NM_000545.8(HNF1A):c.869C>A (p.Pro290His)" [2], "NM_000545.8(HNF1A):c.238G>T (p.Asp80Tyr)" [3], "NM_000545.8(HNF1A):c.681G>A (p.Glu227=)" [4], and "NM_000545.8(HNF1A):c.542G>C (p.Gly181Ala)" [5].
